scope: adaptive exact proof cover of an immutable finite residue

outcome_contract.CERTIFIED_UNSAT_COVER: independently checked LRAT prefixes form an exact disjoint cover of all 4096 leaf assignments
outcome_contract.SAT_WITNESS_REPLAYED: retain and independently replay the complete assignment against the immutable source CNF
outcome_contract.TECHNICALLY_INCOMPLETE: missing, overlapping, unchecked, capped or failed nodes have no mathematical status

artifact_policy: provider artifacts only; compact metadata and proof payloads are separate; download and independently replay proofs one bounded group at a time; no automatic Git commit
